_instructions: Copy to <participant>_<arm>.json and fill in. Delete keys you genuinely could not record rather than guessing; the summariser reports them as unmeasured. Do not add a name, student ID or any other personal detail.
_duration_s: Agent arm: copy duration_s from the tool's exported session summary. Manual arm: stopwatch, start at first read, stop when every criterion has a score.
_decisions: Agent arm only, copied from the exported session summary. edited counts toward M9; rejected is counted separately because the marker discarded rather than changed the suggestion.
_facilitator_interventions: M14. Count only explanations of the interface, not questions about marking judgement.
_evidence: M14 second half. The target is that the second number is 0.

questionnaire._scale: 1 strongly disagree .. 5 strongly agree; null if not asked

manual_arm_scores._note: Manual arm only: the participant's score per criterion, rubric alone.

_observations: Short factual notes. What they hesitated on, what they misread, what they said aloud. Verbatim where possible.
